page_title: EIN 2-2 PAU | Eintracht Frankfurt v St. Pauli 11/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Van Der Heyden S. Red Card

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but lashes his shot way over the bar.
90+4' Ben Alexander Voll (St. Pauli) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+4' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90+1' Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
88' The Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Christian Dingert rules it out for a handball.
85' A lofted pass into the box is met by Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt), who rifles a shot just wide of the left post.
84' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
84' Here is a change. Lars Ritzka is going off and Alexander Blessin gives the last tactical orders to Robert Wagner (St. Pauli).
84' Here comes a substitution. Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) is brought on as a substitute for Morgan Guilavogui.
83' Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
82' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Christian Dingert has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
81' An attempted cross from Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared.
81' Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Dino Toppmoller has decided to substitute Ansgar Knauff and he is replaced by Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt).

78' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) leaps high deep inside the box to meet a beautiful cross from the resultant free kick. He glances a header goalwards, but it's not accurate at all and goes well wide of the left post.
78' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Eric Smith (St. Pauli) was quite harsh and Christian Dingert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
77' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a rough foul. Christian Dingert stops the game and makes a call.
76' Alexander Blessin prepares a substitution. Oladapo Afolayan is replaced by Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli).
73' Christian Dingert blows for a foul after Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

71' 2 - 2 Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.

70' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Ben Alexander Voll. This effort really didn't trouble him.
69' Substitution. Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ellyes Skhiri walks off.
67' A clumsy foul by Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) and Christian Dingert blows his whistle.
67' The ball is cleared after Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
66' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards wide of the left post.
63' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
62' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Christian Dingert no option but to blow his whistle.
61' Dino Toppmoller is forced to make a change. Tuta is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt).
60' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
59' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Philipp Treu limps off the pitch to be replaced by Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli).
58' Philipp Treu (St. Pauli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
57' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
55' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
53' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) and Hugo Ekitike attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
50' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
47' Christian Dingert has a clear sight and sees a foul from Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt).
46' Philipp Treu (St. Pauli) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
46' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on the pitch for Jean-Matteo Bahoya.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Christian Dingert has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Christian Dingert couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) and blew his whistle.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' The game is interrupted. Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
41' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
39' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Christian Dingert blows for a foul.
36' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
34' Wasted effort! Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
33' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
32' Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Christian Dingert blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Eintracht Frankfurt.
31' Eintracht Frankfurt are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
29' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
29' The ball goes out for a corner. St. Pauli can continue in their attacking effort.

28' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. St. Pauli will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
26' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
23' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Christian Dingert saw the whole situation.
22' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
20' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
19' The game is interrupted now, Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
18' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.

15' 1 - 2 Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) runs on to a clever pass from Ben Alexander Voll and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He still has work to do but finishes with aplomb into the back of the net.
15' The resulting set piece from Eintracht Frankfurt is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

15' Ben Alexander Voll pulls off a fantastic save! Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header low towards the right post, but the effort is kept out.
15' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
13' Carlo Boukhalfa (St. Pauli) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
10' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
10' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
8' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a rough challenge and Christian Dingert blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Eintracht Frankfurt failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

6' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Ben Alexander Voll makes a great save to stop his effort. The linesman makes the right call and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a corner.
4' 1 - 1 Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) receives an accurate low pass inside the box and slams the ball home into the top left corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
1' 1 - 0 Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) collects a killer pass inside the box that puts him one-on-one against the goalkeeper. He scores, drilling a low drive deep inside the left post!

St. Pauli will kick-off.
